report.summary: Both failures come from one test-side bug: BooksPage.add() clicks get_by_test_id("add-books"), but the books form button is data-testid="add-book", so the locator never matches and Playwright times out after 5s. Fix the selector in tests/support/pages.py:44 first, which should clear both tests; the app is not at fault.

causes.title: Page object uses a non-existent test id for the Add book button
causes.explanation: BooksPage.add() in tests/support/pages.py:44 clicks get_by_test_id("add-books"). The books template renders the submit button as data-testid="add-book" (app/templates/books.html:9). The locator matches nothing, so click() waits the full 5000ms and raises TimeoutError before any assertion runs. Both tests call books.add() before doing anything else, so both fail at that line. The other book tests (test_book_created_through_api_shows_in_ui, test_deleted_book_disappears) do not use add() and are not in the failure list, which fits this diagnosis. The app behaviour is not under test here, so the failure says nothing about whether the add flow works. The fix is only the selector, but the assertions in these tests (Year must be between, input kept, row listed) have not been exercised yet, so they may still reveal other problems once the click succeeds.
evidence: Search for 'add-books' in the repo returns only tests/support/pages.py:44; no app code uses that id.
tests/ui/test_books_ui.py:13 and :42 both call books.add(...) before any assertion, matching the failing lines in the tracebacks.
causes.suggested_fix: In tests/support/pages.py line 44, change get_by_test_id("add-books") to get_by_test_id("add-book"). Then rerun tests/ui/test_books_ui.py and check that the assertions in test_future_year_shows_error_and_keeps_input (error text, kept input value, zero rows) pass against the real app.
